title: The Bitcoin treasury effect: How 845,000 BTC pumped MSTR’s stock by 16%
summary: Strategy’s latest surge shows how Bitcoin exposure is amplifying MSTR’s stock performance.
content: MicroStrategy's recent stock surge highlights the powerful effect of corporate Bitcoin exposure. With a massive holdings of 845,000 BTC, the company's shares jumped by 16%. This strong market performance demonstrates how tying a public firm's financial strategy directly to cryptocurrency can significantly amplify its stock returns during upward market movements.
content_ta: MicroStrategy நிறுவனத்தின் சமீபத்திய பங்குகள் உயர்வு, கார்ப்பரேட் மட்டத்தில் Bitcoin முதலீட்டின் தாக்கத்தை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது. 845,000 BTC அளவிலான பெரும் சேமிப்புடன், நிறுவனத்தின் பங்குகள் 16% வரை உயர்ந்துள்ளன. சந்தை உயர்வின் போது கிரிப்டோகரன்சி முதலீடுகள் நிறுவனத்தின் பங்கு லாபத்தை எவ்வாறு அதிகரிக்கின்றன என்பதை இந்த வலுவான சந்தை செயல்பாடு காட்டுகிறது.

title: Ant International launches financial AI stack
summary: China's Ant International has unveiled a full stack of AI-native products for payment, account, FX, treasury and growth operations for global businesses.
content: China-based Ant International has launched a comprehensive financial AI stack designed for global businesses. The newly unveiled suite features a range of AI-native products tailored for payment processing, account management, foreign exchange, treasury, and growth operations, aiming to enhance efficiency and capabilities for enterprises worldwide.
content_ta: சீனாவைச் சேர்ந்த Ant International நிறுவனம், உலகளாவிய வணிகங்களுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக வடிவமைக்கப்பட்ட நிதி சார்ந்த செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) தொழில்நுட்ப தொகுப்பை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இப்புதிய தயாரிப்புத் தொகுப்பில் கட்டணச் செயலாக்கம், கணக்கு மேலாண்மை, அந்நியச் செலாவணி மற்றும் வளர்ச்சிப் பணிகள் உள்ளிட்ட பல்வேறு அம்சங்கள் ஏஐ (AI) தொழில்நுட்பத்துடன் ஒருங்கிணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: Oil prices fall as Strait of Hormuz energy flows improve
summary:
Improved energy flows may stabilize oil markets short-term, but geopolitical tensions and OPEC actions will dictate longer-term price trends.
The post Oil prices fall as Strait of Hormuz energy flows improve appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Oil prices experienced a decline following improvements in energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz. While these better conditions could help stabilize global oil markets in the short term, analysts note that ongoing geopolitical tensions and upcoming decisions by OPEC will ultimately dictate longer-term price trends in the energy sector.
content_ta: Strait of Hormuz வழியாக energy flows மேம்பட்டதால் oil prices குறைந்துள்ளது. இந்த குறுகிய கால மாற்றங்கள் oil markets-ஐ stabilize செய்ய உதவக்கூடும் என்றாலும், தொடர்ந்து நிலவும் geopolitical tensions மற்றும் OPEC-ன் முடிவுகள் எதிர்கால price trends-ஐ நிர்ணயிக்கும்.

title: Oracle’s Project Jupiter in New Mexico reportedly mothballed as $18B loan trades at steep discount
summary:
Oracle's Project Jupiter halt highlights financial instability risks in large-scale AI infrastructure, impacting regional economic growth prospects.
The post Oracle’s Project Jupiter in New Mexico reportedly mothballed as $18B loan trades at steep discount appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Oracle’s Project Jupiter in New Mexico has reportedly been mothballed after its massive 18 billion dollar loan began trading at a steep discount. This halt raises concerns regarding the financial stability and risks associated with large-scale artificial intelligence infrastructure projects, potentially impacting regional economic growth and development prospects in the area.
content_ta: New Mexico-வில் உள்ள Oracle நிறுவனத்தின் Project Jupiter திட்டம் கைவிடப்பட்டதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. இதன் பிரம்மாண்டமான 18 பில்லியன் டாலர் கடன் பெரும் தள்ளுபடியில் வர்த்தகம் செய்யப்படுவதால் இந்த முடிவு எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த திடீர் நிறுத்தம் பெரிய அளவிலான AI உள்கட்டமைப்பு திட்டங்களில் உள்ள நிதி ஸ்திரத்தன்மை குறித்த கவலைகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளதுடன், பிராந்தியத்தின் பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி வாய்ப்புகளையும் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: South Korea reports $23B trade surplus for Sept. 1-20 as exports surge 78%
summary:
South Korea's trade surplus highlights its pivotal role in global tech supply chains, but reliance on semiconductors poses economic vulnerability.
The post South Korea reports $23B trade surplus for Sept. 1-20 as exports surge 78% appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: South Korea reported a significant trade surplus of $23 billion for the first twenty days of September, driven by a 78% surge in exports. This impressive economic performance underscores the country's crucial position in global technology supply chains. However, experts note that such heavy reliance on semiconductors could also introduce underlying economic vulnerabilities moving forward.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தின் முதல் இருபது நாட்களில் சவுதி கொரியா 23 பில்லியன் டாலர் வர்த்தக உபரியைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளது, ஏற்றுமதி 78% அதிகரித்துள்ளதே இதற்குக் காரணம். இந்த வலுவான பொருளாதாரச் செயல்பாடு உலகளாவிய தொழில்நுட்ப விநியோகச் சங்கிலியில் நாட்டின் முக்கிய பங்கை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது. இருப்பினும், செமிகண்டக்டர்களை மட்டுமே அதிகமாக நம்பியிருப்பது பொருளாதாரத்தில் எதிர்காலத்தில் பாதிப்புகளை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Circle’s Chandhok outlines Arc’s growth strategy for AI agents
summary:
Arc's strategy could redefine blockchain utility by prioritizing AI-driven transactions, potentially expanding market dynamics beyond human-centric models.
The post Circle’s Chandhok outlines Arc’s growth strategy for AI agents appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Circle's Chandhok has outlined the growth strategy for Arc, focusing on AI agents. This strategy aims to redefine blockchain utility by prioritizing AI-driven transactions. By moving beyond traditional human-centric models, the initiative could significantly expand market dynamics and reshape how blockchain technology is utilized in the evolving digital economy.
content_ta: Circle நிறுவனத்தின் Chandhok, AI agents-களுக்கான Arc-ன் வளர்ச்சி உத்தியை விளக்கியுள்ளார். இந்த உத்தியானது AI அடிப்படையிலான பரிவர்த்தனைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிப்பதன் மூலம் பிளாக்செயின் பயன்பாட்டை மாற்றியமைப்பதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. மனிதர்களை மையமாகக் கொண்ட பாரம்பரிய மாதிரிகளைத் தாண்டிச் செல்வதன் மூலம், இந்த முயற்சி சந்தை இயக்கவியலை கணிசமாக விரிவுபடுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: Congress advances bill to fully deduct gambling losses, reversing cap from earlier tax overhaul
summary:
Restoring full gambling loss deductions may boost the gaming industry but could increase the federal deficit by $2 billion over a decade.
The post Congress advances bill to fully deduct gambling losses, reversing cap from earlier tax overhaul appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Congress has advanced a new bill proposing to fully deduct gambling losses, effectively reversing a previous cap established in an earlier tax overhaul. While this move could provide a boost to the gaming industry, financial analysts warn it may also increase the federal deficit by billions of dollars over the coming decade.
content_ta: சூதாட்ட இழப்புகளுக்கு முழுமையான வரி விலக்கு அளிக்கும் புதிய மசோதாவை Congress முன்னெடுத்துள்ளது. இது முந்தைய வரி சீர்திருத்தத்தின் வரம்பை மாற்றியமைக்கிறது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை கேமிங் துறைக்கு ஊக்கமளிக்கும் அதேவேளையில், வரவிருக்கும் தசாப்தத்தில் கூட்டாட்சி பற்றாக்குறையை அதிகரிக்கக்கூடும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர்.

title: OCC Opens Three Bank Doors to Stablecoins and AI Agents
summary:
U.S. financial regulators have issued conditional approvals for three new national trust banks. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) on Friday (Sept. 18) granted those approvals for Agora National Trust Bank, Catena Trust Bank, while allowing the conversion of Bastion Platforms Trust Company into a national bank. “If you are a bank, […]
The post OCC Opens Three Bank Doors to Stablecoins and AI Agents appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) in the United States has granted conditional approvals for three new national trust banks, including Agora National Trust Bank and Catena Trust Bank. Additionally, Bastion Platforms Trust Company has been permitted to convert into a national bank. These developments reflect ongoing regulatory changes as authorities evaluate the integration of innovative financial technologies like stablecoins and AI agents within the traditional banking system.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவில் உள்ள Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) அமைப்பு, Agora National Trust Bank மற்றும் Catena Trust Bank உட்பட மூன்று புதிய தேசிய டிரஸ்ட் வங்கிகளுக்கு நிபந்தனைக்குட்பட்ட ஒப்புதல்களை வழங்கியுள்ளது. கூடுதலாக, Bastion Platforms Trust Company ஒரு தேசிய வங்கியாக மாற அனுமதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கைகள், பாரம்பரிய வங்கி முறையில் stablecoins மற்றும் AI agents போன்ற புதிய தொழில்நுட்பங்களின் ஒருங்கிணைப்பை ஒழுங்குபடுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளன.

title: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
summary: North Korean cyber group WaterPlum targeted developers with fake jobs at crypto, AI and NFT companies, infecting at least 30,000 devices across more than 100 countries.
content: A North Korean cyber group named WaterPlum has launched a massive campaign targeting software developers through fake job recruitment. Using malicious lures disguised as employment opportunities at artificial intelligence, crypto, and NFT firms, the hackers successfully infected at least 30,000 devices across over 100 countries. The operation resulted in the theft of $10.7 million in cryptocurrency, highlighting a growing threat to tech and digital asset workers.
content_ta: North Korea-வைச் சேர்ந்த WaterPlum என்ற சைபர் க்ரூப், போலி வேலைவாய்ப்புகளை காட்டி சாஃப்ட்வேர் டெவலப்பர்களை குறிவைத்து பெரிய அளவிலான தாக்குதலை நடத்தியுள்ளது. AI, crypto மற்றும் NFT நிறுவனங்களில் வேலை தருவதாகக் கூறி தீம்பொருளைப் பரப்பிய இந்த ஹேக்கர்கள், 100-க்கும் மேற்பட்ட நாடுகளில் குறைந்தது 30,000 சாதனங்களை முடக்கியுள்ளனர். இதன் மூலம் $10.7 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான cryptocurrency திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Xi Jinping heads to Washington to revive a $6B US liquefied natural gas trade
summary:
Reviving US-China LNG trade could reshape global energy markets, influence geopolitical alliances, and impact long-term energy strategies.
The post Xi Jinping heads to Washington to revive a $6B US liquefied natural gas trade appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping is heading to Washington in an effort to revive a multi-billion-dollar liquefied natural gas trade between the two nations. Successfully restarting this energy trade could significantly influence global energy markets, alter geopolitical alliances, and shape long-term energy strategies for both economic superpowers.
content_ta: சீனா நாட்டின் தலைவர் Xi Jinping, இரு நாடுகளுக்கு இடையேயான பல பில்லியன் ட மதிப்புள்ள திரவ இயற்கை எரிவாயு வர்த்தகத்தை மீட்டெடுக்கும் முயற்சியாக Washington செல்கிறார். இந்த எரிசார் வர்த்தகத்தை வெற்றிகரமாக மீண்டும் தொடங்குவது உலகளாவிய எரிசக்தி சந்தைகளில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தி, புவிசார் அரசியல் கூட்டணிகளை மாற்றக்கூடும்.

title: China’s central bank to sell 60 billion yuan in bills through Hong Kong on September 23
summary:
The PBOC's bill issuance in Hong Kong strengthens yuan stability, influences global currency markets, and enhances offshore yuan liquidity.
The post China’s central bank to sell 60 billion yuan in bills through Hong Kong on September 23 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: China's central bank has announced plans to sell 60 billion yuan in bills through Hong Kong on September 23. This move by the People's Bank of China is designed to influence currency markets, enhance offshore liquidity, and support the stability of the yuan.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் 23 அன்று Hong Kong வழியாக 60 பில்லியன் yuan மதிப்பிலான பத்திரங்களை விற்க உள்ளதாக China-வின் மத்திய வங்கி அறிவித்துள்ளது. PBOC-இன் இந்த நடவடிக்கையானது நாணய சந்தைகளில் தாக்கம் செலுத்தவும், வெளிநாட்டு பணப்புழக்கத்தை அதிகரிக்கவும், yuan-இன் ஸ்திரத்தன்மையை ஆதரிக்கவும் உதவும் வகையில் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: US Treasury proposes AI incident notification mechanism after talks with China
summary:
The proposed AI incident notification mechanism could foster transparency and cooperation, potentially easing geopolitical tensions and enhancing global AI governance.
The post US Treasury proposes AI incident notification mechanism after talks with China appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The US Treasury has proposed an AI incident notification mechanism following discussions with China. This initiative aims to foster transparency and cooperation between the nations, potentially easing geopolitical tensions and enhancing global governance surrounding artificial intelligence technologies. The development highlights ongoing international efforts to address risks associated with advanced AI systems through diplomatic engagement.
content_ta: சீனாவுடன் நடத்திய பேச்சுவார்த்தைகளைத் தொடர்ந்து, US Treasury செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு தொடர்பான அசம்பாவித அறிவிப்பு முறையை (AI incident notification mechanism)ப் பரிந்துரைத்துள்ளது. இந்த முன்மொழிவு இரு நாடுகளுக்கும் இடையே வெளிப்படைத்தன்மையையும் ஒத்துழைப்பையும் வளர்ப்பதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது, இது புவிசார் அரசியல் அழுத்தங்களைத் தணிக்கவும் உலகளாவிய AI நிர்வாகத்தை மேம்படுத்தவும் உதவும்.

title: Ethereum leads euro stablecoin market cap growth with $32M increase
summary:

content: Ethereum has driven significant growth in the euro stablecoin market cap, recording an increase of $32 million. This milestone highlights Ethereum's leading position and pivotal role in expanding regulatory-compliant digital finance and influencing broader cryptocurrency market dynamics.
content_ta: யூரோ stablecoin மார்க்கெட் கேப் வளர்ச்சியில் Ethereum முக்கிய பங்கு வகித்து, $32 மில்லியன் அதிகரிப்பை பதிவு செய்துள்ளது. ஒழுங்குமுறைக்கு உட்பட்ட டிஜிட்டல் நிதித்துறையில் Ethereum-ன் ஆதிக்கம் மற்றும் முக்கிய பங்கை இந்த மைல்கல் அடிக்கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

content_ta: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, White House-ல் சீன அதிபர் Xi Jinping-ஐ கவுரவிக்கும் வகையில் நடைபெறும் சிறப்பு விருந்தில் கலந்துகொள்ள உள்ளார். தொழில்நுட்பமும் சான்னாட்டு உறவுகளும் ஒன்றிணைவதை இந்த நிகழ்வு எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: US Virtual Embassy urges American citizens to leave Iran immediately
summary:

title: Latvian Fintech Platforms Draw 800,000 investors, €13bn in Investments
summary: Eight Latvian-regulated Fintech platforms have facilitated more than €13 billion in investments and serve more than 800,000 foreign investors, with German investors accounting for about 30% of demand, Latvia’s investment agency said. The figures were disclosed during a Latvian trade mission to Berlin, where fintech... Read More
content: Latvian-regulated Fintech platforms have successfully attracted more than 800,000 investors and facilitated a staggering €13 billion in investments. According to Latvia’s investment agency, these figures were revealed during a recent trade mission to Berlin. German investors currently account for approximately 30% of the total demand, highlighting the strong cross-border appeal and growing significance of Latvia's digital finance sector within the European market.
content_ta: லட்வியா ஒழுங்குமுறைக்கு உட்பட்ட Fintech தளங்கள் 800,000-க்கும் மேற்பட்ட முதலீட்டாளர்களை ஈர்த்துள்ளன, மேலும் €13 பில்லியன் அளவுக்கு முதலீடுகளை எளிதாக்கியுள்ளன. பெர்லினில் நடைபெற்ற வர்த்தக உச்சிமாநாட்டின் போது இந்த விவரங்கள் வெளியிடப்பட்டதாக லட்வியாவின் முதலீட்டு முகமை தெரிவித்துள்ளது. மொத்த தேவையில் ஜெர்மன் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் சுமார் 30% பங்கைக் கொண்டுள்ளனர் என்று லட்வியா தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

content_ta: Ant International நிறுவனத்தின் பேமெண்ட் ஒருங்கிணைப்பு சேவைகளில் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவைப் (AI) பயன்படுத்தும் வர்த்தகர்களின் எண்ணிக்கை கடந்த ஆண்டில் நான்கு மடங்காக அதிகரித்துள்ளதாகத் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த ஃபின்டெக் நிறுவனம் தனது பேமெண்ட், அந்நிய செலாவணி, கருவூலம் மற்றும் கிரெடிட் செயல்பாடுகளில் AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தை விரிவுபடுத்தி வருகிறது. விரைவில் பெரும்பான்மையான வர்த்தகர்கள் இந்த மேம்பட்ட AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துவார்கள் என்று இந்நிறுவனம் எதிர்பார்க்கிறது.

title: Kalshi faces ‘fake crypto volume’ allegations as critic flags identical $5,500 trades
summary:

content: Prediction market platform Kalshi is facing scrutiny over its reported cryptocurrency trading volumes after a critic highlighted suspicious trading patterns, including identical trade amounts. A former quant trader pointed out a large discrepancy between the platform's reported daily volume and its open interest. In response, a Kalshi representative defended the platform, explaining that critics may be misunderstanding prediction markets compared to traditional perpetual futures and clarifying that rebates are not offered for these crypto markets.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி டிரேடிங் வால்யூம் தொடர்பான சந்தேகத்திற்கிடமான வர்த்தக முறைகளால் கணிப்பு சந்தை தளமான Kalshi விமர்சனங்களை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளது. தளத்தின் தினசரி வால்யூம் மற்றும் ஓபன் இன்ட்ரெஸ்ட் இடையே பெரிய வித்தியாசம் உள்ளதாக முன்னாள் குவாண்ட் டிரெடர் ஒருவர் சுட்டிக்காட்டினார். இதற்குப் பதிலளித்த Kalshi பிரதிநிதி, பாரம்பரிய பெர்பச்சுவல் பியூச்சர்ஸுடன் கணிப்பு சந்தைகளை விமர்சகர்கள் தவறாகப் புரிந்துகொண்டிருக்கலாம் என்றும், கிரிப்டோ சந்தைகளுக்கு ரிபேட்டுகள் வழங்கப்படவில்லை என்றும் விளக்கமளித்தார்.

title: Bank of Korea launches 24-hour won settlement pilot for foreign investors
summary: The Bank of Korea’s new network will let foreign investors settle won transactions during business hours in their home countries.
content: The Bank of Korea has launched a 24-hour won settlement pilot system for foreign investors. This new network allows international investors to settle won transactions conveniently during regular business hours within their own home countries. The initiative aims to improve market accessibility and streamline financial operations for foreign participants interacting with South Korea's currency market.

title: Bitcoin Reclaims 50-Week Moving Average for the First Time in Over 10 Months
summary: According to an analyst, the historical odds of a cycle low after a 50-week MA reclaim are 75% and 100% when the Covid crash is excluded.
content: Bitcoin has successfully reclaimed its 50-week moving average for the first time in over ten months. According to market analysts, historical data suggests that after such a reclaim, the odds of a market cycle low are significantly high, reaching up to one hundred percent when excluding extreme events like the Covid crash.
content_ta: Bitcoin ப, பத்து மாதங்களுக்கும் மேலான காலத்திற்குப் பிறகு, தனது 50-week moving average-ஐ வெற்றிகரமாக மீட்டுள்ளது. சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, இத்தகைய மீட்சிக்குப் பிறகு சந்தையின் cycle low ஏற்படுவதற்கான வரலாற்று வாய்ப்புகள் மிக அதிகம் என்றும், Covid crash போன்ற நிகழ்வுகளைத் தவிர்த்தால் இது நூறு சதவீதமாக இருக்கும் என்றும் கூறப்பட்டுள்ளது.

content: Bitcoin recently rebounded by 9% near the $74,000 level despite a Federal Reserve rate hike. title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Rockets to $155,000 in Bitfinex Market Glitch

title: USDT on TRON Becomes Most Used Onchain Payment Option on CoinsBee as Stablecoin Spending Grows
summary: CoinsBee payment data shows USDT on TRON recorded nearly twice as many payments as Bitcoin over the past 90 days, while its share of all payments on CoinsBee increased by 64% compared with 2025.   Stuttgart, Germany, September 21, 2026 – CoinsBee, a global platform that makes it easy to use cryptocurrency for everyday purchases, today announced that USDT (TRC-20) on the TRON network has become the most-used onchain token and network payment option on CoinsBee, according to payment data from the global crypto gift card platform. Over the 90-day period ending September 1, 2026, USDT on TRON recorded approximately 1.8 times as many payments on CoinsBee as Bitcoin and 1.9 times as many as Ethereum. Its share of payment activity has also substantially increased. USDT on TRON accounted for 16.23% of all payments on CoinsBee in 2026 to date, compared with 9.92% in 2025. This represents a 64% increase in its share of total payments. The data provides insight into how cryptocurrency holders use digital assets for everyday retail purchases, in addition to trading and investing. CoinsBee allows customers in more than 180 countries to purchase gift cards, payment cards, gaming credits and mobile top-ups from more than 5,000 global and local brands using over 200 cryptocurrencies. USDT on TRON is also responsible for a large share of USDT spending on the platform. Over the past 90 days, TRC20 accounted for 44.6% of USDT payments on CoinsBee but 64.5% of USDT turnover. This indicates that the average value of USDT purchases made through TRON was higher than purchases made through other networks that support USDT. In the United States, the most purchased brands using USDT on TRON during the same period included Amazon, Apple, AT&T, PlayStation, Uber, Macy’s, T-Mobile, Walmart, Sephora and DoorDash. The purchases covered categories including retail, mobile connectivity, gaming, transport and food delivery. These findings are based on CoinsBee payment data. The 90-day analysis covers the period from June 4 through September 1, 2026, and includes successfully paid and delivered orders. It compares payments by cryptocurrency and blockchain network. Payment counts represent completed payments rather than transaction value, while turnover represents the value of the corresponding purchases on CoinsBee. The comparison of payment share uses 2026 data to date and full year 2025 data. Payment share represents each token and network combination as a percentage of total completed payments on CoinsBee during the respective period. With this momentum, CoinsBee and TRON DAO are launching a joint campaign focused on the use of USDT on TRON for everyday purchases. From September 21 through October 5, 2026, CoinsBee will offer eligible users of the CoinsBee mobile app a 2% discount on purchases paid with USDT on TRON. Users can enter the code USDT-TRC in the CoinsBee app and select USDT on TRON as their payment method to activate the discount. This offer is available once per user. Subject to conditions. Full campaign terms and eligibility requirements are available on the CoinsBee website. “USDT on TRON is already the most used onchain payment option on CoinsBee, and its share of payments has grown considerably over the past year,” said Iván Escamilla Rodriguez, Product and Growth Lead at CoinsBee. “What is particularly interesting for us is that this activity translates into purchases across categories such as retail, mobile services, gaming and food delivery. Our payment data gives us a direct view into how people use stablecoins when they want to spend their assets.” “Stablecoins become more useful when people can use them for products and services they already purchase,” said Sam Elfarra, Community Spokesperson at TRON DAO. “TRON provides infrastructure for USDT transactions at global scale, and the collaboration with CoinsBee gives users another way to use USDT for everyday purchases.” The campaign highlights the growing use of USDT on TRON with CoinsBee’s catalog of more than 5,000 global and local brands. CoinsBee serves more than 500,000 customers and supports cryptocurrency payments for gift cards and digital products across ecommerce, gaming, entertainment, travel, food, fashion, mobile services and other categories.   About CoinsBee CoinsBee is a global platform that makes it easy to use cryptocurrency for everyday purchases. Founded in 2019, CoinsBee enables customers to buy gift cards, payment cards, gaming credits, and mobile top-ups using more than 200 cryptocurrencies. Available in over 180 countries, CoinsBee serves more than 500,000 customers and provides access to gift cards and digital products from more than 5,000 global and local brands across categories including e-commerce, gaming, entertainment, travel, food, fashion, and more. By connecting cryptocurrencies with products and services people use every day, CoinsBee helps make digital assets practical beyond trading and investing. The platform continues to expand its global reach, supported cryptocurrencies, and brand selection to make spending crypto simple, fast, and accessible.   Media Contact Erik Rossol press@coinsbee.com  About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps. Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of September 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 405 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.”   TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum Media Contact Yeweon Park press@tron.network
content: CoinsBee payment data shows that USDT on TRON has become the platform's most-used onchain payment option, recording nearly twice as many payments as Bitcoin over a recent 90-day period. title: FintechOS Secures $28M in Combined Equity and Debt Refinancing
summary:
FintechOS, the agentic platform for Unified Product Operations serving banks, insurers and other financial services companies across the United States and Europe, announced it has raised $28 million in combined equity and debt financing from its current shareholder base, including Bek Ventures, IFC, Cipio Partners and Molten Ventures, alongside a senior debt facility from Santander CIB. The investment will be used to further set up the company’s expansion base in the United States, deepen its European client portfolio, and scale the delivery practice behind its AI-native platform. 
The round follows a strong first half of 2026 for FintechOS, during which the company confirmed it had reached profitability while growing recurring revenue 40% year-on-year for the first half of 2026, driven in large part by 130% growth in the US market. Operational EBITDA had climbed to more than 102% year-on-year, as gross margin gains allow the company to fund its next phase of growth without slowing down. The company expects to close a record number of new customers in 2026, with more than 20 new financial institutions worldwide adopting their AI-native platform, FintechOS 8. 
"Reaching profitability was not an accident, it was the outcome of a deliberate, multi-year effort to get our cost base, our margins and our delivery practice right before we pushed harder on growth again," said Cyril Desouza, CFO of FintechOS. "Now that discipline is paying off twice over: the business has reached profitability, and we've already made the shift back into high growth, which is exactly the combination that lets us take on a round like this one." 
"Growth and profitability go hand in hand, not at the expense of one another," said Teo Blidarus, Founder and CEO of FintechOS. "Santander CIB's support, alongside other investors that trust us, is a strong vote of confidence in the path we're on, and it gives us the capital to go after the extraordinary potential we see ahead, particularly in the US, without compromising the discipline that got us to profitability in the first place." 
Doubling Down on the US, Consolidating Europe 
The United States has been FintechOS’s fastest-growing market for the past year, and the company is now moving to scale that momentum further. FintechOS is appointing a strong set of Board Directors in the US market, including a new Chairman, to help drive the strategy for the next phase of the company’s expansion and strategic partnerships across the region, building on the 130% year-on-year growth already achieved there. The company is targeting more than 200% year-on-year growth in the US over the next twelve months. 
FintechOS’s strategic partnership with Finxact (part of Fiserv, one of the largest core banking and payments providers in the US) builds on existing partnerships such as the one with Finastra Phoenix, another leading core banking provider, opening the door to a new pool of bank and credit union clients set to join a roster that already includes ESL Federal Credit Union, Vibrant Credit Union, Hanscom Federal Credit Union, Farmers Bank of Willards, MHG Insurance and others. 
Alongside its US acceleration, FintechOS is consolidating its presence in European banking and insurance, partnering with new customers in the UK while also continuing strong partnerships with systemic organisations including BRD Groupe Société Générale, Admiral, CEC Bank, Howden, Bankinter, Groupama, and many others. 
Native AI Enabling a New Approach to Delivery 
The AI-native approach of the platform, where non-technical users can configure products and offers directly within Dex, the AI copilot, alongside the full range of Unified Product Operations capabilities, is changing the way financial institutions deploy innovation and enables a new delivery approach for FintechOS. 
Alongside its US leadership expansion, FintechOS is introducing this new forward-deployed practice, built around agile client-facing pods, each comprised of a forward-deployed technical consultant and a forward-deployed engineer. Rather than a traditional, more distant implementation approach, these pods work closely with client product teams to configure and launch on FintechOS faster. The practice is designed to drive greater operational efficiency for clients, cut time to market on new products, and lower the total cost of ownership of their solutions, translating the speed of the company’s AI-native platform into speed of deployment and value on the ground. 
FintechOS Elevate ’26: The Company’s Flagship Event 
FintechOS will bring this next phase of growth to FintechOS Elevate ’26, its flagship executive conference, taking place on 14 October 2026 in London. The invite-only event convenes 250 leaders in financial services who are using AI to deliver product innovation, exceptional customer experience and operational efficiency. This year’s edition will host world-renowned guests and speakers, including Dharmesh Mistry, author of The Intelligent Ledger and a veteran of four decades in banking technology, and Leda Glyptis, client-first executive, non-executive director, advisor and author, alongside executive and AI leadership from leading banks and insurers.

title: Riverty Officially Opens New Bank in Luxembourg
summary:
Riverty has officially opened Riverty Bank S.A. in Luxembourg, marking an important milestone in the fintech company's growth strategy and creating the platform to further expand its payments and consumer finance offering across Europe.
 
The bank was officially opened at a ceremony in Luxembourg attended by Gilles Roth, Luxembourg's Minister of Finance, Claude Marx, CSSF Director General, Thomas Rabe Bertelsmann Chairman and CEO, Carsten Coesfeld, Bertelsmann Executive Board member responsible for Riverty, Andreas Barth, Riverty CEO and Oliver Kuhaupt, Riverty Bank CEO, alongside representatives from business, finance and the Luxembourg ecosystem.
 
The opening also marks the start of the bank's next phase under the leadership of Oliver Kuhaupt, who has been appointed CEO of Riverty Bank S.A. and Board Representative of Riverty Group, and Marc Pittig, who has been appointed Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Riverty Bank. As CEO, Oliver Kuhaupt assumes overall responsibility for the bank's strategy execution, business operations and market development. In his role as Chief Banking Officer, he represents the bank and its strategic development within the broader Riverty organisation. As CFO, Marc Pittig is responsible for the bank's financial management, regulatory compliance and risk management, helping build a strong financial foundation for Riverty Bank's long-term growth.
 
Setting Riverty Bank up for growth
 
Riverty Bank builds on an established European payments business. Riverty today works with more than 1,800 merchants and 25 million consumers across 10 European countries, processing more than €10 billion in transaction volume annually.
 
The new bank provides the platform for Riverty to further develop its consumer finance capabilities and bring payments and credit together into an integrated proposition for merchants and their customers.
Under the ambition "Designed for merchant growth," Riverty is building a financial powerhouse that enables merchants to seamlessly integrate payments and consumer finance into their customer proposition. By combining regulated banking capabilities with embedded finance solutions, Riverty helps merchants grow sustainably, strengthen customer relationships and create better purchasing experiences across Europe.
 

Andreas Barth, CEO of Riverty, said:
 
"The opening of Riverty Bank is an important milestone for the Riverty Group and gives us a strong foundation for our next phase of growth. By bringing payments and consumer finance closer together, we can create greater value for our merchants and their customers across Europe.
 
Oliver has played a central role in building Riverty Bank and is the right person to lead it as CEO. Together with Marc Pittig as CFO and an outstanding leadership team, we have built a strong foundation for the bank's next chapter. The banking licence is an important enabler, but what matters most is what it allows us to do for our merchants—help them grow through trusted, innovative financial solutions."
 

Oliver Kuhaupt, CEO of Riverty Bank and Chief Banking Officer of Riverty, said:
"Our strategy can be summed up in four words: Designed for merchant growth. Everything we build starts with the needs of our merchants. Our ambition is to build a bank that enables our business partners to seamlessly integrate payments and consumer finance into their value creation, helping them forge better customer experiences and grow their businesses sustainably.
 
Establishing Riverty Bank in Luxembourg has been an extraordinary journey. We have found a strong financial ecosystem, deep banking expertise and a network of partners that provides an excellent foundation from which to grow.”
 
A new chapter in Luxembourg
Luxembourg provides Riverty Bank with access to a well-established financial ecosystem, deep banking expertise, a strong talent pool and a network of potential partners. These were among the factors highlighted by Riverty in establishing the bank in Luxembourg.
The opening ceremony reflected both Riverty's ambitions for the bank and the wider relationship between Bertelsmann and Luxembourg, with speakers addressing the role of fintech, the development of Riverty Bank and Luxembourg's position as a leading European financial centre.
Gilles Roth, Finance Minister Luxembourg said:
“Riverty Bank’s decision to establish itself in Luxembourg is a vote of confidence in our financial centre and in Luxembourg as a base for European business.”
The ceremony concluded with the official ribbon cutting by Gilles Roth, Finance Minister Luxembourg, Claude Marx, Director General CSSF, Thomas Rabe CEO Bertelsmann, Carsten Coesfeld Executive Board Member Bertelsmann, Andreas Barth CEO Riverty Group, Oliver Kuhaupt CEO Riverty Bank & Marc Pittig CFO Riverty Bank formally marking the opening of Riverty Bank in Luxembourg.

title: Ascory Bank AG Enters into a Strategic, Long-Term Partnership with Mount Street to Deliver Outsourced Credit Administration and Surveillance

The mandate combines Mount Street’s specialist credit management expertise with technology-enabled operations and a robust governance framework, providing Ascory with a scalable operating model as its portfolio grows and regulatory requirements evolve.
The partnership reflects the increasing demand among regulated financial institutions for specialist outsourcing solutions that combine experienced personnel, established governance frameworks and scalable technology. Mount Street's teams have extensive experience supporting banks, institutional investors and asset managers across a broad range of asset classes and complex portfolio structures.
The services will be delivered through Mount Street Portfolio Advisers GmbH, Mount Street's BaFin-regulated entity, which forms part of the wider Mount Street Group, including FCA-regulated businesses.

Stephan Plagemann, CFO Mount Street said: "This mandate brings together Mount Street’s specialist loan administration expertise, robust data management and scalable technology in a single integrated solution. By combining operational servicing, portfolio oversight and workflow automation, we can help Ascory improve efficiency, strengthen governance and build a more transparent platform for future portfolio growth.”
Supporting contractual arrangements include a dedicated Data Processing Agreement and an Agreement on the Fulfilment of Regulatory Obligations in Connection with ICT Outsourcing. title: Binance Enters the 24/7 FX Perpetual Market With Up to 100x Leverage
summary:
Binance is expanding its TradFi derivatives offering with the launch of 24/7 Foreign Exchange (FX) perpetual futures, bringing currency-market exposure to its futures platform.
The first contract, USDBRLUSDT, tracks the U.S. Dollar against the Brazilian Real (USD/BRL) and is scheduled to launch on September 21, 2026 at 14:00 UTC. The contract will be settled in USDT and will offer up to 100x leverage.
What’s New?
Unlike traditional FX markets, which generally operate during specific market hours and close on weekends, Binance’s FX perpetual contract will be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Binance will use different pricing mechanisms depending on market conditions. During regular FX trading hours, the price index will use weighted prices from third party data providers. During weekends and public holidays, Binance will use an order book based EWMA pricing mechanism designed to support continuous trading when traditional FX liquidity is thinner.
Key Details
Contract: USDBRLUSDT
- Underlying: USD/BRL
- Settlement: USDT
- Trading: 24/7
- Maximum leverage: 100x
-  Funding settlement: Every 8 hours
- Funding rate cap: +0.375% / -0.375%
-  Launch: September 21, 2026, 14:00 UTC
 Leverage Comes With Risk
The introduction of 100x leverage means traders can take significantly larger positions with a smaller amount of margin. However, high leverage can also magnify losses and increase liquidation risk.
Binance also notes that product availability may vary by jurisdiction and that contract parameters can be adjusted based on market conditions.
With this launch, Binance is bringing 24/7 FX exposure into the same perpetual futures environment familiar to crypto traders.

title: FCA and Partners Join Forces to Help Improve Financial Security for Millions
summary:
While the market is working well for consumers who have protection insurance, millions of people remain unprotected.
Around 58% of adults have no life insurance, critical illness cover or income protection – and 59% of that group has never considered it. This means that millions could be left vulnerable in the event of a death in the family, serious illness or loss of income.
To help more people consider whether protection insurance is right for them, the FCA will join forces with partners from industry, government and consumer groups. Actions include:
The Money and Pensions Service and the Digital Property Market Steering Group will prompt people to think about protection at key moments - such as becoming a parent or buying or renting a home. The FCA is also exploring how other partners can help put protection on people’s radar when it matters most.
The Protection Distributors' Group will lead a consumer awareness campaign, targeted at groups who are less likely to take out protection products.
The Association of Mortgage Intermediaries will lead work to help advisers improve how they discuss protection with their customers.
The work follows the FCA’s Pure Protection Market Study. The work will focus on groups who are disproportionately unprotected – such as renters, the self-employed and gig economy workers, those on lower incomes and people with pre-existing medical conditions.
Graeme Reynolds, director of competition at the FCA, commented:
'Competition in protection insurance works well for existing customers. But we’re working with partners to increase coverage – so that more people are protected when they or their families need it most.'
The FCA wants to see greater innovation in this market. It will hold a webinar for firms to address any misunderstandings about its rules and expectations that may be seen as barriers. It will also work with the Association of British Insurers to reduce delays in obtaining medical records and is inviting firms to take part in a TechSprint - they should express their interest by 13 November.

content: A new browser experiment called HashFly is testing whether digital neural models inspired by fruit fly brains can perform Bitcoin hashing. title: Sony Says You Don't Own the Games You Bought. Crypto Says It Can Fix That

title: Will proposed faster block times really fix Ethereum’s biggest market losses?
summary:
EIP-8198 keeps throughput broadly flat while tightening the propagation and attestation windows that protect broad participation.
The post Will proposed faster block times really fix Ethereum’s biggest market losses? appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A proposed update called EIP-8198 aims to address Ethereum's market losses by introducing faster block times. The proposal keeps overall network throughput broadly flat while tightening the propagation and attestation windows. This adjustment is designed to protect broad participation within the network, raising questions about whether these changes will effectively resolve Ethereum's ongoing market challenges.
content_ta: Ethereum-ன் மார்க்கெட் இழப்புகளை சரிசெய்ய வேகமான பிளாக் நேரங்களை அறிமுகப்படுத்தும் EIP-8198 என்ற புதிய மேம்பாடு பரிந்துரைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த முன்மொழிவு நெட்வொர்க்கின் ஒட்டுமொத்த செயலாக்க திறனை சீராக வைத்திருக்கும் அதே வேளையில், பரிமாற்ற மற்றும் ஒப்புதல் நேர சுருக்கங்களை இறுக்குகிறது. இந்த மாற்றங்கள் Ethereum-ன் தற்போதைய மார்க்கெட் சவால்களை திறம்பட தீர்க்குமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்புகின்றன.

title: Strategy Buys Another 950 Bitcoin As Holdings Reach 846,000 BTC
summary: TL;DR Strategy bought 950 BTC during the week ending September 20 for $75.7 million. The purchases were made at an average price of $79,670 per Bitcoin. Strategy now reports 846,000 BTC acquired for an aggregate $63.80 billion. Strategy has added another 950 Bitcoin to its balance sheet, extending the corporate treasury strategy that continues to define the company. An SEC filing dated September 21 shows the purchases were made between September 14 and September 20 for an aggregate $75.7 million in cash. The average purchase price was $79,670 per BTC. Strategy’s Bitcoin Stack Reaches 846,000 BTC Following the latest acquisition, Strategy reported total holdings of 846,000 BTC. The company says those coins were acquired for an aggregate $63.80 billion, putting its average acquisition price at $75,416 per Bitcoin. The timing is worth keeping precise. The filing landed on September 21, but it covers purchases made over the prior week rather than a single transaction executed on filing day. That distinction has become increasingly important with Strategy’s regular treasury updates, which often bundle several purchases into one disclosure. The same filing also shows the company repurchased 1,771,238 shares of its STRC preferred stock for $174 million. Corporate Treasury Strategy Keeps Expanding Strategy’s latest move reinforces how aggressively it continues to use the public markets and its capital structure to support a Bitcoin-heavy balance sheet. At 846,000 BTC, the company’s exposure is no longer a side allocation. Bitcoin is central to how investors value the business, how its financing activity is interpreted and how changes in BTC price feed through to the company’s balance-sheet narrative. The latest purchase was made above Strategy’s aggregate average cost, which also means every incremental acquisition at current levels nudges that blended cost basis higher. For now, the key confirmed figures are the 950 BTC weekly purchase and the resulting 846,000 BTC total. The filing does not indicate that all 950 BTC were bought on September 21 itself. title: Bitcoin Reclaims $85,000 For First Time In Eight Months
summary: TL;DR Bitcoin crossed $85,000 on September 21, reaching a session high of $85,174.35. That marked BTC’s highest spot level since January 2026. The move is a price milestone, not confirmation of a new bull-market leg. Bitcoin pushed through $85,000 on September 21, putting the market back at a level it had not seen since January. The move took BTC to a session high of $85,174.35, according to the validated spot-price snapshot used for this report. That makes the reclaim notable for a simple reason: the market spent roughly eight months below this part of the range. Bitcoin Returns To An Eight-Month High The cleanest way to read the move is as a change in where Bitcoin is trading, rather than an invitation to attach a larger forecast to it. Crossing $85,000 matters because it restores a price zone that had effectively remained out of reach through much of 2026. It also gives traders a new reference point after months in which rallies repeatedly failed to push BTC back toward its January highs. What the move does not establish on its own is how durable the break will be. A session high can tell us where buyers were able to push price; it cannot, by itself, tell us whether the market will hold that level over the next several daily closes. That distinction matters especially in Bitcoin, where a headline level can attract both fresh spot demand and short-term derivatives positioning at the same time. The Next Test Is Whether $85,000 Holds For now, the confirmed development is straightforward: BTC traded above $85,000 and printed its highest spot level in eight months. The more useful follow-up will come from how the market behaves around the reclaimed zone. If Bitcoin can spend time above it rather than immediately slipping back below, $85,000 could begin functioning as a more meaningful reference level. If the move fades quickly, the session may instead be remembered as another volatility spike inside a still-fragile range. Either way, the September 21 move has already changed the short-term market picture by putting a price that had been absent since January back on the board. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae. Source: Primary Source

content_ta: அதிகரித்து வரும் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு செலவுகள் காரணமாக, மென்பொருள் உருவாக்குநர்கள் ஓபன்-வெயிட் மாடல்களை நோக்கி அதிகளவில் திரும்பி வருகின்றனர். அமெரிக்காவின் விலை உயர்ந்த பிரோபிரியட்டரி மாடல்களுக்கு மாற்றாக, சீன மாடல்கள் உள்ளிட்ட மலிவான விருப்பங்களை நிறுவனங்கள் தேர்வு செய்து வருவதாக ப்ளூம்பெர்க் செய்தி வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. ஓபன்-வெயிட் மாடல்கள் நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் சொந்தத் தரவைப் பயன்படுத்தி தனிப்பயனாக்கப்பட்ட தீர்வுகளை உருவாக்க அனுமதிக்கின்றன, இதன் மூலம் செலவுகளும் அவுட்சோர்சிங் அபாயங்களும் குறைக்கப்படுகின்றன.

content: The ISO/IEC 42001 standard may emerge as a key governance benchmark for artificial intelligence in the payments sector.
